description.la: Septem collationes de decem praeceptis Decalogi, Parisiis anno 1267 habitae. Textus ex editione Quaracchi (Opera omnia V, 1891), ex scanno OCR, sine notis criticis.
description.en-US: Seven collations on the Ten Commandments, preached at Paris in Lent 1267. The text is the Quaracchi edition (Opera omnia V, 1891) from an OCR scan, without the editors’ critical notes.
description.pt-BR: Sete colações sobre os dez mandamentos, pregadas em Paris na Quaresma de 1267.

sources.edition: S. Bonaventurae Opera omnia, tom. V (Ad Claras Aquas, Quaracchi: Collegium S. Bonaventurae, 1891), pp. 505-532.
sources.description: Archive.org OCR (djvu.xml word coordinates) of the folio edition. Each page is read in two columns; marginal notes, running heads, the editors’ Summarium and footnotes (variant readings, cross-references) are removed by layout (line pitch and measure); line-end hyphens are joined; recognisable OCR slips are corrected by a lexicon pass, so some remain.
sources.tierEvidence: Bonaventure died in 1274; the Quaracchi edition of 1891 is public domain.
